profile.headline: React Native & Frontend Developer | Shipped production mobile app to 1,500+ users | TypeScript · React · REST APIs | Open to Remote
profile.summary:
I build things that ship.
As the sole frontend engineer at Presale.Codes, I took a React Native app 
from zero to production: 1,500+ downloads, 100-300 daily active users, 
and 600+ concurrent users during peak concert presale events on the App 
Store and Google Play. Not a portfolio project. A live, revenue-generating 
product with real users and real consequences when things break.
Since then I've been the dedicated Software Engineer for G&R Landmark LLC, 
a home renovation company in the Charlotte area, where I own everything 
software-related: a production website with local SEO and schema markup 
deployed on Cloudflare, a client invoicing workflow, and an in-house 
estimate generation app currently in development.
My background spans the full stack: React Native, React, TypeScript, REST 
APIs, Laravel, Python, MySQL. But my sharpest edge is frontend and mobile. 
I think in components, debug with intention, and care about what the end 
user actually experiences.
What I bring to a team:
→ Solo ownership experience: I've shipped products end to end without 
   hand-holding
→ Real production debugging: cross-platform subscription failures, 
   high-concurrency performance, live DOM bugs
→ Startup pace: I'm used to wearing multiple hats and prioritizing what 
   actually matters
Currently seeking full-time Frontend or React Native roles, remote or 
anywhere in the US. Open to relocation.
Let's connect: pedrogrjr3@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Sole software engineer for a revenue-generating home renovation business 
in the Charlotte, NC area, responsible for all things software, 
independently scoped and executed.

- Designed and deployed a production business website (gr-landmark.com) 
  with geo-targeted SEO, Local Business JSON-LD schema markup, a 
  config-driven dynamic image gallery, and a Web3Forms contact integration, 
  hosted on Cloudflare Pages with custom DNS via GoDaddy

- Conducted a full SEO overhaul: canonical tags, Open Graph metadata, 
  Google Search Console sitemap submission, and structured data markup, 
  improving local search visibility across the greater Charlotte area

- Building an in-house estimate generation app to replace manual quoting 
  workflows, reducing administrative overhead and standardizing 
  client-facing proposals

- Implemented a digital client invoicing workflow, replacing informal 
  billing processes with a structured, trackable system

- Diagnosed and resolved a production gallery filter bug caused by a stale 
  NodeList reference, demonstrating real-world debugging on a live 
  business site

positions.title: React Native Software Engineer
positions.description:
As the sole frontend engineer, I owned the entire client-side of a 
cross-platform React Native app from first commit to App Store and 
Google Play, serving a live, paying user base.

- Built and shipped a React Native (TypeScript) mobile app from scratch: 
  1,500+ downloads, 100-300 daily active users, peaking at 600+ concurrent 
  users during high-demand concert presale events (Bad Bunny, Beyoncé)

- Architected the full UI/UX: event listings, real-time search, single 
  event view, and subscription-based content locking, integrated with 
  backend REST APIs in direct collaboration with a senior backend engineer

- Diagnosed and resolved a critical cross-platform revenue failure using 
  Chrome DevTools and network logs: identified a schema mismatch between 
  Apple and Google Play transaction IDs that was silently breaking 
  subscriptions across Android devices

- Reduced load times and mitigated crash risk during 600+ concurrent user 
  spikes by implementing lazy-loading and refactoring monolithic components 
  into modular, on-demand architecture

- Built a secure token-based authentication system and managed full 
  deployment compliance for both App Store and Google Play

- Triaged incoming user feedback during peak traffic windows, 
  deprioritizing cosmetic requests to protect stability and maintain 
  100% uptime during high-pressure presale events
